raw.source: US BIS - Department of Commerce Rescinds Biden-Era Firearms Rule, Restoring Common Sense to Export Controls on Civilian Firearms
raw.content_en: BIS has rescinded the Biden-era firearms export rule, easing licensing and marking requirements for civilian firearms and ammunition under the Export Administration Regulations. Exporters of civilian firearms, parts, and accessories to the US market should re-verify ECCN classification (EAR vs. ITAR/USML), confirm the rescinded rule's effective scope, and update internal compliance programs. US HTS alignment, Section 301 tariff exposure, and BIS Entity List screening remain mandatory. Reassess license exceptions, end-user statements, and recordkeeping before resuming or expanding shipments.
raw.content_zh: 美国商务部工业与安全局（BIS）撤销了拜登时期的枪支出口规则，放宽了民用枪支及弹药在《出口管理条例》下的许可与标识要求。向美国市场出口民用枪支、零部件及配件的企业应重新核实ECCN分类（EAR与ITAR/USML的界限），确认被撤销规则的实际生效范围，并更新内部合规程序。美国HTS归类、301条款关税风险及BIS实体清单筛查仍为强制要求。在恢复或扩大出货前，应重新评估许可例外、最终用户声明及记录保存义务。

checklist.desc: Confirm whether civilian firearms, parts, and accessories fall under EAR ECCNs (e.g., 0A501/0A502) or ITAR USML after the rescission; document classification rationale and retain technical specs.

checklist.task: BIS Entity List & restricted party screening
checklist.desc: Screen all US consignees, end-users, and intermediaries against the BIS Entity List, SDN, and denied persons lists; retain screening records and end-use/end-user statements.
Map the 10-digit HTS line (e.g., 9302.00, 9303.20, 9303.30) against Section 301 lists and additional duties; document country of origin and value build-up to quantify tariff exposure.
Reassess eligibility for license exceptions under the rescinded rule, revise SOPs, and confirm 5-year recordkeeping for export transactions and end-user documentation.

checklist.task: FCC / product safety conformity where applicable
checklist.desc: For electronic sights, optics, and accessories with RF or electrical components, confirm FCC Part 15/18 conformity and supplier FCC IDs before US entry.
